"""Independent tiny-Git probes; no canonical source mutation, model or execution grant."""
import asyncio,hashlib,json,sys
import argparse
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from unittest.mock import patch
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()))
from devtools.core.paths import resolve_path
from devtools.resources.commands import Command,CommandExecutor,CommandOutputPolicy
from devtools.resources.filesystem.errors import FilesystemNotFoundError
from scripts.backlog import checkout
from scripts.backlog.coordinator import git,designate
from scripts.backlog.work import WorkCycle
O=Path(__file__).parent;CANONICAL=Path.cwd();SOURCE='src/devtools/sample.py';OLD='value = 0\n';A='value = 1\n';B='value = 2\n'
async def setup(root):
 assert root!=CANONICAL
 root.mkdir();(root/'src/devtools').mkdir(parents=True);(root/SOURCE).write_bytes(OLD.encode());(root/'.gitignore').write_text('.local/\n',encoding='utf-8')
 (root/'docs/backlog').mkdir(parents=True);(root/'docs/backlog/overview.md').write_text('# Independent empty fixture backlog\n',encoding='utf-8')
 for args in [('init','-b','fixture'),('config','user.name','Independent Audit'),('config','user.email','audit@localhost'),('add','.'),('commit','-m','Tiny authored owner fixture')]:await git(root,*args)
 await designate(root,authorize=lambda _:True)
 return WorkCycle(root),await git(root,'rev-parse','HEAD')
def lease(cycle,base):return checkout.Checkout(cycle,'independent-fixture','fixture',base,files=[dict(path=SOURCE,text=OLD)])
async def abandon_in_child(root,base):
 code='''import asyncio,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,sys.argv[1])
from scripts.backlog.work import WorkCycle
from scripts.backlog.checkout import Checkout
async def main():
 root=Path(sys.argv[2]);c=Checkout(WorkCycle(root),'stopped-child-fixture','fixture',sys.argv[3],files=[dict(path='src/devtools/sample.py',text='value = 0\\n')])
 await c.__aenter__();c.expect('src/devtools/sample.py','value = 1\\n');(root/'src/devtools/sample.py').write_bytes(b'value = 1\\n')
asyncio.run(main())
'''
 r=await CommandExecutor(output_policy=CommandOutputPolicy(max_stdout_bytes=1<<20)).execute(Command(sys.executable).args('-I','-B','-c',code,str(CANONICAL),str(root),base).cwd(resolve_path(root)))
 assert not r.failed,(r.stdout,r.stderr)
 value=json.loads((root/'.local/backlog/checkout-owner/owner.json').read_text())
 assert value['pid']!=__import__('os').getpid() and (root/SOURCE).read_text()==A
 return dict(child_exit=r.exit_code,owner_pid=value['pid'],owner_sha=value['sha256'])
async def simple_cases():
 rows=[]
 for mode in ['competing','unknown','corrupt','foreign_root','branch_changed','explicit_no','known_recovery','repeated_recovery','before_switch','after_switch']:
  with TemporaryDirectory(prefix='devtools-owner-audit-') as tmp:
   root=resolve_path(Path(tmp)/'repo').value;c,base=await setup(root);owner=lease(c,base)
   child=None
   if mode in ['before_switch','after_switch']:
    await git(root,'branch','feat/target',base);owner.branch='feat/target';original=checkout.git
    async def fail(r,*args,**kwargs):
     if args[:2]==('switch','feat/target'):
      if mode=='after_switch':await original(r,*args,**kwargs)
      raise RuntimeError('Injected ambiguous Git return')
     return await original(r,*args,**kwargs)
    with patch.object(checkout,'git',fail):
     try:await owner.__aenter__()
     except RuntimeError:pass
     else:raise AssertionError('Fault did not enter')
    owned=owner.folder.exists();branch=await git(root,'branch','--show-current')
    assert owned
    await checkout.recover(c,authorize=True)
    assert not owner.folder.exists() and await git(root,'branch','--show-current')=='fixture'
    rows.append(dict(case=mode,adapter_entered=True,actual_switch_entered=mode=='after_switch',branch_after_error=branch,owner_retained=owned,recovery_returned_to_original=True));continue
   child=await abandon_in_child(root,base)
   error=None
   if mode=='competing':
    try:await lease(c,base).__aenter__()
    except PermissionError as e:error=str(e)
    else:raise AssertionError('Competing owner admitted')
   else:
    if mode=='unknown':(root/SOURCE).write_text('unrecognized = True\n',encoding='utf-8')
    if mode in ['corrupt','foreign_root']:
     p=owner.folder/'owner.json';v=json.loads(p.read_text());v['root']='foreign-root'
     if mode=='foreign_root':
      from scripts.backlog.intake import _digest
      v['sha256']=_digest({k:x for k,x in v.items() if k!='sha256'})
     p.write_text(json.dumps(v),encoding='utf-8')
    if mode=='branch_changed':await git(root,'switch','-c','feat/foreign')
    try:await checkout.recover(c,authorize=mode!='explicit_no')
    except (PermissionError,FileNotFoundError) as e:error=type(e).__name__+': '+str(e)
    if mode in ['unknown','corrupt','foreign_root','branch_changed','explicit_no']:assert error and owner.folder.exists()
    elif mode=='repeated_recovery':
     try:await checkout.recover(c,authorize=True)
     except (FileNotFoundError,FilesystemNotFoundError):error='Filesystem not found; no retained owner to repeat'
     else:raise AssertionError('Repeated recovery invented a completion')
   rows.append(dict(case=mode,child=child,error=error,owner_retained=owner.folder.exists(),source=(root/SOURCE).read_text(),branch=await git(root,'branch','--show-current')))
 return rows
async def recovery_race():
 with TemporaryDirectory(prefix='devtools-recovery-race-') as tmp:
  root=resolve_path(Path(tmp)/'repo').value;c,base=await setup(root);child=await abandon_in_child(root,base)
  stopped=asyncio.Event();resume=asyncio.Event();original=checkout.git;stale=None
  async def schedule(r,*args,**kwargs):
   if asyncio.current_task() is stale and args[:2]==('restore','--source=HEAD'):
    stopped.set();await resume.wait()
   return await original(r,*args,**kwargs)
  with patch.object(checkout,'git',schedule):
   stale=asyncio.create_task(checkout.recover(c,authorize=True))
   await asyncio.wait_for(stopped.wait(),10)
   await checkout.recover(c,authorize=True)  # Same stopped owner; first recovery completes.
   new=lease(c,base);await new.__aenter__();new.expect(SOURCE,B);(root/SOURCE).write_bytes(B.encode())
   owner_before=(new.folder/'owner.json').read_bytes();assert (root/SOURCE).read_text()==B
   resume.set();error=None
   try:await stale
   except Exception as e:error=type(e).__name__+': '+str(e)
  row=dict(case='stale_recovery_crosses_new_owner',expectation='A stale recovery must not restore a new owner source or remove its claim',child=child,new_source_before=B,source_after=(root/SOURCE).read_text(),new_owner_exists_after=new.folder.exists(),new_owner_record_preserved=(new.folder/'owner.json').exists() and (new.folder/'owner.json').read_bytes()==owner_before,error=error)
  row['violates_expected_contract']=row['source_after']!=B or not row['new_owner_record_preserved']
  assert row['violates_expected_contract'],row
  return row
async def stale_consent():
 from scripts.backlog import __main__ as cli
 with TemporaryDirectory(prefix='devtools-consent-audit-') as tmp:
  root=resolve_path(Path(tmp)/'repo').value;c,base=await setup(root);child=await abandon_in_child(root,base)
  displayed=json.loads((root/'.local/backlog/checkout-owner/owner.json').read_text());new_owner=None;replacement={}
  async def replace_owner():
   nonlocal new_owner,replacement
   await checkout.recover(c,authorize=True)
   new_owner=lease(c,base);await new_owner.__aenter__();new_owner.expect(SOURCE,B);(root/SOURCE).write_bytes(B.encode())
   replacement=json.loads((new_owner.folder/'owner.json').read_text())
  def answer(prompt):
   assert 'recorded owner is stopped' in prompt
   with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1) as bridge:bridge.submit(lambda:asyncio.run(replace_owner())).result()
   return 'y'  # Synthetic terminal decision applies only to the owner already displayed.
  with patch.object(sys.stdin,'isatty',lambda:True),patch.object(sys.stdout,'isatty',lambda:True),patch('builtins.input',answer):
   result=await cli._work(argparse.Namespace(command='work-recover'),root)
  row=dict(case='recovery_consent_rebound_to_replacement',expectation='Consent for displayed stopped owner A must not authorize a later owner B',child=child,displayed_sha=displayed['sha256'],displayed_pid=displayed['pid'],replacement_sha=replacement['sha256'],replacement_pid=replacement['pid'],replacement_process_is_current=True,expected_preserved_source=B,source_after=(root/SOURCE).read_text(),new_owner_exists_after=new_owner.folder.exists(),returned=result,terminal='Explicit synthetic I/O inside tiny fixture only, not a real user approval or grant')
  row['violates_expected_contract']=row['displayed_sha']!=row['replacement_sha'] and (row['source_after']!=B or not row['new_owner_exists_after'])
  assert row['violates_expected_contract'];return row
async def main():
 value=dict(method='Real tiny Git repositories and an actual exited child owner; cooperative faults schedule real Git effects. No standing grants, model outputs, approvals or protected publication are fabricated.',baseline='264915928a9045795d5e07c728ffa1aaba4c1704',cases=await simple_cases(),recovery_race=await recovery_race(),stale_consent=await stale_consent())
 (O/'probes.json').write_text(json.dumps(value,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8');print(json.dumps(value,indent=2))
if __name__=='__main__':asyncio.run(main())

import asyncio,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()));sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).parent))
from probes import setup,lease,OLD,SOURCE,O
from devtools.core.paths import resolve_path
from scripts.backlog.checkout import Checkout
from scripts.backlog.coordinator import git
from scripts.backlog.delegation import Delegations
from apps.qwen.tasks import MARKDOWN
async def main():
 value=json.loads((O/'probes.json').read_text());rows=[]
 task=MARKDOWN
 policy=dict(categories=['bug'],sources=[task.source],tests=list(task.tests),oracles=[task.oracle_sha256],per_task=dict(calls=3,output_tokens=4096,seconds=900,edits=3),total=dict(tasks=1,calls=3,output_tokens=12288,seconds=900))
 assignment=dict(backlog=dict(proposal=dict(payload=dict(kind='bug'))))
 for case in ['applicable_only','foreign_source','foreign_oracle','calls_exceeded','category_mismatch']:
  p=json.loads(json.dumps(policy));a=json.loads(json.dumps(assignment))
  if case=='foreign_source':p['sources']=['src/devtools/other.py']
  if case=='foreign_oracle':p['oracles']=['a'*64]
  if case=='calls_exceeded':p['per_task']['calls']=1
  if case=='category_mismatch':a['backlog']['proposal']['payload']['kind']='investigation'
  try:Delegations.eligible(p,a,task)
  except PermissionError as e:assert case!='applicable_only';rows.append(dict(case=case,error=str(e),authority_created=False))
  else:assert case=='applicable_only';rows.append(dict(case=case,policy_applicable=True,authority_created=False))
 value['policy_probes']=rows
 with TemporaryDirectory(prefix='devtools-collision-audit-') as tmp:
  root=resolve_path(Path(tmp)/'repo').value;c,base=await setup(root)
  (root/'.gitignore').write_text('.local/\ncollision.txt\n',encoding='utf-8');await git(root,'add','.gitignore');await git(root,'commit','-m','Ignore fixture collision')
  await git(root,'switch','-c','feat/target');(root/'collision.txt').write_text('tracked target\n',encoding='utf-8');await git(root,'add','-f','collision.txt');await git(root,'commit','-m','Target fixture path');target=await git(root,'rev-parse','HEAD');await git(root,'switch','fixture')
  link=root/'collision.txt'
  try:link.symlink_to('missing-fixture-target')
  except OSError as e:row=dict(case='ignored_dangling_collision',state='UNAVAILABLE_OS_SYMLINK_PERMISSION',error=str(e),not_a_defect_reproduction=True)
  else:
   assert link.is_symlink() and not link.exists()
   error=None;entered=False
   try:
    async with Checkout(c,'ignored-link-fixture','feat/target',target):entered=True
   except (PermissionError,ValueError) as e:error=str(e)
   row=dict(case='ignored_dangling_collision',expectation='Refuse before a Git switch can overwrite an ignored dangling link',entered=entered,link_preserved=link.is_symlink(),exists=link.exists(),error=error,branch=await git(root,'branch','--show-current'))
   row['violates_expected_contract']=not row['link_preserved']
  value['ignored_collision']=row
 (O/'probes.json').write_text(json.dumps(value,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8');print(json.dumps(dict(policy_cases=len(rows),ignored_collision=row),indent=2))
asyncio.run(main())

limitations: Only independently authored temporary Git repositories, actual stopped child owner, controlled fault schedule and synthetic terminal I/O. No actual Devtools source mutations, execution grants, models or promotion.
Before/after-switch fault adapter does not establish every OS/process failure behavior.
Initial missing fixture overview and wrong expected exception were harness failures, corrected before product results; not product defects.
Five pure delegation-policy probes create no authority. Full grant/expiry/assignment tests are maintained tests with explicit fixture authority.
Self-consistent hashes are not protection against a fully malicious local state writer.
